# MakeMyCV.ae

> MakeMyCV.ae (brand name always written with the ".ae"; not related to makemycv.com) is a free, ATS-clean CV builder designed for the UAE and GCC job market (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah). No sign-up, no paywall, no watermark. The builder keeps the CV in the user's browser; the ATS checker and the cover letter tool send only what the privacy policy describes. Built for UAE-specific hiring: a dedicated "UAE Essentials" step covers visa status, nationality, driving licence, notice period and availability, and every template works with or without a photo (user's choice per application). Templates use the single-column, standard-section structure that ATS software parses reliably.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.makemycv.ae/): What MakeMyCV.ae is, who it's for, and why UAE CVs need ATS-clean formatting.
- [Templates](https://www.makemycv.ae/templates): All 14 free CV templates — ATS-friendly single-column layouts (Classic, ATS Clean, Professional, Gulf Standard, Harvard, Chronicle) and design-led formats (Executive, Modern, Executive Split, Corporate, Onyx, Sandstone, Banner, Professional Photo). Every layout is available with or without a photo.
- [Free CV Maker for Dubai](https://www.makemycv.ae/free-cv-maker-dubai): How the free Dubai CV maker works, the UAE fields it adds, and the template choices.
- [ATS Resume Checker](https://www.makemycv.ae/resume-checker): Free check of whether a CV passes the applicant tracking systems UAE employers use.
- [JD Match](https://www.makemycv.ae/jd-match): Paste a job description and see how closely a CV matches it, with the specific gaps to fix. The CV is compared in the browser.
- [UAE CV Examples](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae): Weak-versus-strong CV bullet rewrites for six UAE sectors, with links to the ten role pages below. All examples are illustrative, not real CVs.
- [Build a CV (app)](https://app.makemycv.ae): The free builder tool — 10 steps, PDF and DOCX download, no account.
- [Cover Letter (app)](https://app.makemycv.ae/cover-letter): Drafts a cover letter from an excerpt of the user's CV and a pasted job description; the model is instructed not to add figures, and any number it would add is replaced by a placeholder for the user to fill.

## CV examples by role
Each page has a direct answer to what the CV should include, five illustrative weak-versus-strong bullets, the UAE Essentials for that role with official sources for the legal and licensing points, and the skills an ATS matches.
- [Accountant CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/accountant): Month-end close, VAT returns through EmaraTax, payables and receivables, audit support and Corporate Tax; how to state ACCA or CA status.
- [Sales Executive CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/sales-executive): Revenue against target in AED, new accounts, pipeline and territory; driving licence and languages.
- [Customer Service Agent CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/customer-service-agent): Daily contact volume, CSAT, handling time and escalations; languages and shift availability.
- [Nurse CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/nurse): How to write the DHA, DOH or MOHAP licence line (in Dubai, a DHA registration that the hiring facility activates into a licence), unit and patient ratio, life-support certificates.
- [Civil Engineer CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/civil-engineer): Projects by type, AED value and role; safety record; Dubai's rule (Administrative Resolution No. 253 of 2021) that contracting-company engineers hold Society of Engineers UAE membership.
- [HR Officer CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/hr-officer): Recruitment and onboarding numbers, Wage Protection System payroll, end-of-service under Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021.
- [Logistics Coordinator CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/logistics-coordinator): Shipment volumes, customs documents, clearance time, freight savings and delivery performance.
- [Receptionist CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/receptionist): Visitor and call volumes, bookings and office admin; visa status, including family sponsorship and visit visas.
- [Real Estate Agent CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/real-estate-agent): Deals, listings and lead conversion; how to state the RERA broker card that Dubai brokers must hold.
- [Hotel Front Desk Agent CV Example](https://www.makemycv.ae/cv-examples-uae/hotel-front-desk-agent): Room count, check-ins per shift, upselling revenue and guest scores; Opera PMS and languages.

## Free tools
- [UAE Gratuity Calculator](https://www.makemycv.ae/gratuity-calculator): End-of-service gratuity under Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021: 21 days of basic pay per year for the first five years and 30 days per year after, capped at two years' pay. Since 2 February 2022 resignation and termination pay the same gratuity. Inputs: where you work (mainland and most free zones, DIFC, ADGM), basic monthly salary, service dates, reason for leaving. Shows the day-by-day breakdown.
- [Notice Period Calculator](https://www.makemycv.ae/notice-period-calculator): Notice to give or receive under UAE Labour Law (30 to 90 days after probation, 14 or 30 days during it), the last working day, and pay in lieu of notice, which is calculated on the full wage.
- [Annual Leave Calculator](https://www.makemycv.ae/annual-leave-calculator): Annual leave entitlement in the UAE (30 days a year after one year of service) and what unused leave days are worth at the end of service, calculated on basic pay.
- [Resignation Letter Generator](https://www.makemycv.ae/resignation-letter-generator): Builds a resignation letter for a UAE employer with the notice period and last working day filled in; copy it or download it, no sign-up.

- [15 UAE CV Mistakes That Get Applications Filtered Out](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/uae-cv-mistakes): The mistakes that stop applications before a recruiter reads them — visa status, two-column templates, Emirates ID numbers, salary history — and the one-line fix for each.
- [MOHRE CV Format](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/mohre-cv-format-uae): What "MOHRE CV format" actually means in the UAE, and what MOHRE does and does not specify.
- [CV vs Resume in the UAE](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/cv-vs-resume-uae): Why both terms mean the same 1–2 page document in the UAE.
- [Dubai CV vs Abu Dhabi CV](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/dubai-cv-vs-abu-dhabi-cv): Formatting, tone and emphasis differences between the two markets.
- [Should Your CV Have a Photo in the UAE?](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/should-cv-have-photo-uae): The UAE photo convention vs Western rules, and ATS-safe placement.
- [Professional Summary Examples for UAE CVs](https://www.makemycv.ae/blog/professional-summary-examples-uae-cv): Ready-to-use summary examples by industry.
